# sarj-rule-contracts

Shared immutable rule metadata and executable examples for Sarj linters.

```bash
uv add sarj-rule-contracts
```

Standard-library-only immutable contracts for rule documentation, metadata, and executable examples. Native engines and the Standards catalog share these declarations. Language parsers, analysis contexts, diagnostics, and suppression policies belong to their engines.

[Documentation](https://code-standards.sarj.ai/) · [Source](https://github.com/sarj-ai/code-standards)
